name: south-indian-tutor
description: TalkVerse - Multi-Mode Indic Language Platform with Python PKL Pronunciation Model

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const ai = spawn('python', ['ai_engine/app.py'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const b = spawn('npm', ['start'], { cwd: './talkverse-backend', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const f = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: './langbridge', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { ai.kill(); b.kill(); f.kill(); process.exit(); });"
